subject: The 2AM scan that saved her
preview_text: We analyzed 10,000 users and found one pattern that predicts a breakup 3 months early.
body_paragraphs: We ran the numbers on 10,000 users. One thing kept showing up: the people who scanned conversations at 2AM were 80% more likely to spot a red flag their partner had been hiding for months. Not a coincidence. Not a fluke. It's the hour when your gut finally screams loud enough to listen.

Here's what shocked us: the average user waits 47 days after their first scan to act on what they see. That's 47 days of ignoring a 4.2 toxicity score, 47 days of 'maybe it's not that bad.' The ones who acted within 48 hours? They cut toxic patterns by 90%. Your gut already knows the answer. The app just gives you proof.

Open your Red Flag Scanner AI and look at your Relationship Health Dashboard. That little green bar? It's lying to you if you haven't scanned a conversation in the last week. The 'Pattern Detection' feature shows you the exact phrases that keep repeating across your chats — the subtle gaslighting, the love bombing that fades. One scan reveals what your bestie won't say.

Open the app now. Scan the last text your partner sent when you felt off. Don't wait 47 days. P.S. — Of the 800 users we helped, the ones who scanned at least 3 conversations in a week never got ghosted again. Your move.
